digest.component_or_area: rebar review CLI verb / LLM review op deprecation
propositions: The single-pass rebar review CLI verb is retired by turning it into a loud deprecation shim that forwards to review-plan while preserving read-only, unsigned semantics.
The shim unconditionally forwards --no-sign so the bare verb writes no attestation, and rejects --graph and a positional reviewer_id with argparse exit code 2 naming review-plan.
The shim accepts the review-plan fast-fail divergence: a non-claimable ticket exits 2 (INDETERMINATE) with no LLM call instead of running the model.
Three scheduled deprecation rows (cli:rebar review, lib:rebar.llm.review_ticket, mcp:review_ticket) are registered with remove_in v1.0.0, all superseded by the plan-review surface.
The public review_ticket function is split into a warning public wrapper plus a silent _review_ticket_impl so MCP, eval, and diff harnesses fire exactly one deprecation signal on their boundary.
The output schema key "review" is repointed to PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT and REVIEW_RESULT is rewired under a synthetic "review_ticket" key to avoid orphaned schemas.
